chunks: Al-Fadl, from Ibn Mahbub, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The rising of the Qaim is an inevitable matter. I asked: 'How will the call be made?' He replied: 'A caller will call from the sky at the beginning of the day: Know that the truth is with Ali and his Shia. Then Iblis, may God curse him, will call at the end of the day: Know that the truth is with Uman and his followers.' At that time, the false ones will fall into doubt.

key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Qaim (The Riser), a title for Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.)
key_terms.الْمُبْطِلُونَ: The false ones/those who deny the truth

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of the call from the sky before the reappearance of Imam Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* underscores the inevitability (al-Mahmum) of the Qaim’s emergence, framing it within the cosmic struggle between truth and falsehood. The dual announcement—divine in the morning and satanic in the evening—serves as a pivotal test of faith, exposing the doubt of the *Mubtilun* (those who distort the truth) by contrasting the legitimacy of Ahl al-Bayt with the rival claim of Uthman. This event highlights the eschatological significance of the 'People of the Book' and 'People of the Sword' narratives, where the final verification of divine authority is revealed through supernatural signs.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 461 - It is narrated from Fadhl from Ibn Mahbub from Ali bin Abi Hamza from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:

“The rising of Imam Qaim (a.s) is an inevitable matter.” I asked: “How will it be announced?” He replied: “A caller will call out from the sky in the morning: Know that the truth is with Imam Ali (a.s) and his Shia. And then in the evening, Iblis will call out from the sky: Know that the truth is with Uthman and his followers.” At this time people of falsehood would fall into doubt.
